notes: Module is 1×9 bi-directional transceiver Tx1310/Rx1550 per title and ordering row L9-SC315501-60CTC. Operating data rate stated as up to 155Mbps and 155.52 Mbps (Recommended Operating Conditions); ordering table lists 155Mb/s. Rx sensitivity ordering S(dBm) is <-34; characteristic table lists Sensitivity typ -34 dBm at 60km. Features list standard operating case temperature 0 to +70°C; ordering row for this part lists Working Tem -10~70℃. Absolute/recommended tables also list TC 0–70°C and TI -40–85°C for industrial variant. Supply current Icc max 250 mA (no power in W stated). Signal Detect Range -45 to -35 dBm; not labeled as LOS assert/deassert. Central wavelength table rows: 1270–1350 nm (1310 FP) and 1510–1590 nm (1550 DFB); this SKU uses 1310 nm FP Tx.
suggestions: Consider a separate field or unit tag for bit_rate when datasheets quote Mbps (e.g. 155.52). form_factor enum may include legacy 1×9/Bi-Di packages. Clarify mapping of Signal Detect Range vs LOS thresholds.
